summary: The layout renders cleanly across mobile viewport except for text overlap defects in the MaterialTokens showcase component.

issues.title: Text collision in material hierarchy panel
issues.description: Specimen text and token metadata labels overlap horizontally due to constrained container width.
issues.evidence: Specimen text lines collide directly with ULTRATHIN, THIN, and REGULAR label columns in the preview card.
issues.suggestion: Adjust layout to stack metadata or hide underlying specimen text on narrow viewports.
